caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of black and gray on a plain light background, depicting the front of a mission-style building. The central element is a structure with an arched doorway flanked by two columns and a set of wide, curved stairs leading up to it. The building's façade has a triangular gable with three circular details and a quatrefoil window above the entrance. A cross sits at the peak of the gable. On each side of the main structure, there are arched openings; to the right is a fully intact archway attached to the building, while to the left is a partially ruined arch attached to a low wall. Beneath the stairs and structure, a banner contains the text "1797 Mision Santa Margarita," with another smaller banner behind it. The drawing displays shading to suggest depth and texture on the surfaces.
title: Mision Santa Margarita
